sections.Profile:
The "Dealer" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 8, 1953, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams. The game incorporates a card-playing theme, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
